4) Vendor onboarding: W9 in the SOW is fine. If we need a vendor portal onboarding, AP will reach out; for now remit@spark-events.com is sufficient.

I will ask AP to prioritize this — target release by EOD Thu 8/27 provided we receive the signed SOW and invoice.

PO & contact: REDWOOD-PO-2026-5118 | AP contact: ap-invoices@redwood.com.
